pairs.subject: english
pairs.evidence: src/i18n/en.ts:3474 The source catalog still ships em dashes (34 in en.ts) under a declared em-dash ban, along with UK spellings, Title Case with ampersands, routine 'Please' and participle tails, and every defect carries into the 13 locales translated from it.

techniques.evidence: src/i18n/en.ts:2491 EN-SPELLING: the contract declares US, but en.ts has the UK forms 'Cancelled' (also 3081) and 'Cancelling...' (2505); they are baselined as debt, not fixed.

src/i18n/en.ts:3304 EN-PLEASE: routine validation prompt where the reader is at fault; same pattern at 3476. The waitlist surface also mixes 'Could not copy' (3303) with "You're" (3293), which is EN-CONTRACTION.

src/i18n/en.ts:3518 EN-CASE plus EN-AMPERSAND: guide categories at 3518-3525 are Title Case with '&', though sentence case is declared; also 'Test Flow'/'Event Types' (2500-2501) and hyphen-as-dash at 3305.
src/i18n/en.ts:3310 EN-ERROR: the generic error doesn't say what happened; 3477 is the same shape.

src/i18n/en.ts:3659 EN-PARTICIPLE-TAIL ', healing itself if a step ever fails' plus dash density; nearby narration also stacks fragment runs ('six pillars, one place' 3660, 'Full transparency, zero setup.' 3665), which is EN-STACCATO.

techniques.evidence: src/app/features/page.tsx:20 EN-DASH: em dash in the OG title (and in the OG description at line 22) despite the house em-dash ban.
src/app/features/page.tsx:22 EN-SERIAL: 'the agent lab and plugins' has no serial comma, while line 18 on the same page uses one ('the agent lab, and a plugin ecosystem').
src/app/features/page.tsx:49 EN-LIST-PARALLEL: the scroll-map nav mixes nouns (DESIGN, MEMORY), a gerund (HEALING) and a verb (OBSERVE) across 9 items, above the 2-7 bound.
